name: Windows Bitmap
doc: Windows / OS/2 device-independent bitmap (BMP) file. A 14-byte BITMAPFILEHEADER is followed by a DIB header whose first field (its size in bytes) selects the variant (12 = BITMAPCOREHEADER, 40 = BITMAPINFOHEADER, 52 = V2 and 56 = V3 (unofficial Adobe variants: info plus RGB / RGBA masks), 108 = BITMAPV4HEADER, 124 = BITMAPV5HEADER), then optional colour masks (BI_BITFIELDS / BI_ALPHABITFIELDS with a 40-byte header), an optional colour table, then the pixel data at the offset given in the file header. All integers are little-endian. Pixel rows are stored padded to a multiple of 4 bytes: stride = ((bpp * width + 31) / 32) * 4 (integer division). Colour-space FourCCs in V4/V5 headers appear byte-reversed on disk ("sRGB" is stored as 42 47 52 73). Headerless DIBs have no "BM" signature and are not detected. The OS/2 2.x 64-byte header (and any other unrecognised header size) is kept as raw bytes. Not modelled: gaps between the colour table and the pixel data, and the contents of embedded ICC profiles (only their location and size).

file.doc: The whole file: file header, DIB header, optional colour masks and palette, pixel data, optional ICC profile.

fields.name: file_header
fields.doc: BITMAPFILEHEADER (14 bytes).

fields.name: dib
fields.doc: DIB header; its variant is chosen by its size field.

fields.name: masks
fields.doc: Colour masks stored right after a 40-byte BITMAPINFOHEADER when compression is BI_BITFIELDS (3 masks) or BI_ALPHABITFIELDS (4 masks). Larger headers carry the masks inside the header.

fields.name: palette_core
fields.doc: Colour table of an OS/2 BITMAPCOREHEADER bitmap: 2^bpp RGBTRIPLE entries when bpp <= 8, none otherwise.

fields.name: palette
fields.if: dib.size == 40 or dib.size == 52 or dib.size == 56 or dib.size == 108 or dib.size == 124
fields.doc: Colour table of RGBQUAD entries: clr_used entries if non-zero, otherwise 2^bpp when 1 <= bpp <= 8, otherwise none (bpp 0 is valid for BI_JPEG / BI_PNG). The count is clamped (with an error) if it cannot fit in the file.

fields.name: pixels
fields.size: (dib.size == 40 or dib.size == 52 or dib.size == 56 or dib.size == 108 or dib.size == 124) and dib.body.size_image != null ? max(0, min(_io.size - file_header.off_bits, dib.body.size_image != 0 ? dib.body.size_image : (dib.body.height < 0 ? -dib.body.height : dib.body.height) * (((dib.body.bpp * (dib.body.width < 0 ? 0 : dib.body.width) + 31) / 32) * 4))) : _io.size - file_header.off_bits
fields.doc: Raw pixel data, located at off_bits. Its size is size_image if non-zero, otherwise abs(height) * stride, clamped to the end of the file (to the end of the file for headers of unknown size). Rows are padded to 4-byte multiples; for positive height the first stored row is the bottom row.

assert.message: off_bits points inside the headers or the colour table

fields.name: profile
fields.doc: Embedded ICC profile (PROFILE_EMBEDDED); profile_data is relative to the start of the DIB header.

fields.name: profile_link
fields.doc: Path of the linked ICC profile (PROFILE_LINKED), a NUL-terminated latin1 string (size bounds the field; the terminator is trimmed from the value).

fields.name: magic
fields.doc: bfType: the ASCII characters "BM".

fields.name: file_size
fields.doc: bfSize: size of the file in bytes (not always accurate in the wild).

fields.name: reserved1
fields.doc: bfReserved1: reserved, should be 0.

fields.name: reserved2
fields.doc: bfReserved2: reserved, should be 0.

fields.name: off_bits
fields.doc: bfOffBits: offset from the start of the file to the pixel data.

dib_header.doc: DIB header. The first field is the header size, which identifies the variant; the remaining fields are parsed in a substream of exactly size - 4 bytes so a corrupt size cannot make the parser run past the header.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Header size in bytes: 12 (core), 40 (info), 52 (V2), 56 (V3), 108 (V4) or 124 (V5).

fields.name: body
fields.doc: The rest of the header. Unknown header sizes (including OS/2 2.x 64-byte headers) are kept as raw bytes.

bitfield_masks.doc: Colour masks that follow a 40-byte header for BI_BITFIELDS (RGB) and BI_ALPHABITFIELDS (RGBA).

fields.name: red
fields.doc: Red channel mask.

fields.name: green
fields.doc: Green channel mask.

fields.name: blue
fields.doc: Blue channel mask.

fields.name: alpha
fields.doc: Alpha channel mask (BI_ALPHABITFIELDS only).

bitmap_core_body.doc: BITMAPCOREHEADER (OS/2 1.x) after the size field: 8 bytes.

fields.name: width
fields.doc: Image width in pixels (unsigned WORD).

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Image height in pixels (unsigned WORD; always bottom-up).

fields.name: planes
fields.doc: Number of colour planes; must be 1.

fields.name: bpp
fields.doc: Bits per pixel: 1, 4, 8 or 24.

assert.message: unusual bits-per-pixel value for a core header

bitmap_info_body.doc: BITMAPINFOHEADER after the size field: 36 bytes.

fields.name: width
fields.doc: Image width in pixels (signed LONG).

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Image height in pixels. Positive: bottom-up DIB, the first row in the file is the bottom row. Negative: top-down DIB, the first row is the top row (the absolute value is the height).

fields.name: planes
fields.doc: Number of colour planes; must be 1.

fields.name: bpp
fields.doc: Bits per pixel (biBitCount): 0 (BI_JPEG/BI_PNG: taken from the embedded stream), 1, 4, 8, 16, 24 or 32.

fields.name: compression
fields.doc: Compression method (biCompression).

assert.message: a top-down bitmap (negative height) must be BI_RGB or BI_BITFIELDS

fields.name: size_image
fields.doc: Size of the pixel data in bytes; may be 0 for BI_RGB.

fields.name: x_pels_per_meter
fields.doc: Horizontal resolution, pixels per metre.

fields.name: y_pels_per_meter
fields.doc: Vertical resolution, pixels per metre.

fields.name: clr_used
fields.doc: Number of palette entries actually used; 0 means the maximum for the bit depth (2^bpp for bpp <= 8).

fields.name: clr_important
fields.doc: Number of palette entries needed to display the image; 0 means all.

ciexyztriple.doc: CIEXYZTRIPLE: CIE XYZ endpoints of the three primaries (36 bytes).

ciexyz.doc: CIEXYZ: one endpoint, three FXPT2DOT30 (2.30 fixed point) values.

rgbquad.doc: RGBQUAD palette entry (4 bytes), stored blue-first.

rgbtriple.doc: RGBTRIPLE palette entry (3 bytes) used by the OS/2 core header, stored blue-first.
